records.command:
@'
import urllib.request,json
models=['intfloat/multilingual-e5-small','sentence-transformers/paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2','BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5','BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3','Alibaba-NLP/gte-multilingual-base','Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B']
rows=[]
for model in models:
 d=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen('https://huggingface.co/api/models/'+model))
 cfg=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen('https://huggingface.co/'+model+'/resolve/'+d['sha']+'/config.json'))
 card=d.get('cardData') or {}
 langs=card.get('language') or []
 rows.append({'id':model,'revision':d['sha'],'license':card.get('license'),'parameters':d.get('safetensors',{}).get('total'),'modelType':cfg.get('model_type'),'hiddenSize':cfg.get('hidden_size',cfg.get('d_model')),'vocabulary':cfg.get('vocab_size'),'contextPositions':cfg.get('max_position_embeddings'),'languagesClaimed':len(langs) if isinstance(langs,list) else langs,'hebrewListed':('he' in langs or 'iw' in langs) if isinstance(langs,list) else False,'source':'https://huggingface.co/'+model})
print(json.dumps(rows,indent=2))
open('.dip-local/semantic-alternatives-metadata.json','w',encoding='utf-8').write(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
'@ | & '.\.dip-local\laya-env\Scripts\python.exe'
